paragraphs.text: Bryce was a city-state in Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria . It was located near the mouth of the River Toloron and the Bay of Pearls . Its governor was Hazezon Tamar .

Bryce was a brown city of stone clinging to the shoreline of the Bay of Pearls , much hidden behind a tall stone wall split by the many fingers of the glittering River Toloron . Bryce was nicknamed the City of Bridges, or the City of Canals because the River Toloron splintered as it fed the Bay of Pearls. After many attempts by city engineers to force the river into set channels, they'd finally given up and simply bridged the many fingers of water. Thus Bryce was picturesque, as beautiful and delicate as spun glass, with arching stone bridges and intersecting canals, but spread out and shot full of holes that made it impossible to defend. Built on stilts and rocks and flats, Bryce stood a little above sea level and hosted 12,000 citizens in the early War with Phyrexia era. Like the other cities of the Craggy Coast and Palmyra upriver, Bryce had been formed from rough and cutthroat pirates and sand bandits. However, its lucrative position at the intersection of the river and the coastline meant that Bryce grew soft and rich, its former pirates easing into a life of luxury, eventually viewing banditry as an annoyance. Reformed pirates hated practicing pirates, and after Bryce hanged a few wild buccaneers, life settled into a dull contentment of counting coins and flaunting wealth.
The Bridge of Ancestors - the oldest bridge of the city
The Bridge of Flowers - richly decorated with flower pots
The Bridge of the Immaculate Wind
The Bridge of Sorrows - where the heartbroken go to cry
The Hanging Gardens - the richest quarter of the city
The Palace of the Tetrarch - the seat of the city's ruler
The Poor Quarter - cramped abodes of squalor along the docks
The Shipwright's Guildhall - a building which housed the owners and builders of ships.
The Temple of Anthius - tended to by the Keepers of the Faith

In the period around 3330 AR , Bryce was often attacked by neighboring Tirras . However, the Battle of Bryce was the first battle in Johan's War , when Tirrans swarmed the streets of Bryce and almost managed to claim a part of the city through the efforts of the young wizard Xira Arien , who was able to defeat Hazezon Tamar 's sand warriors through the use of Stone-Throwing Devils . However, Bryce had recently befriended the cat warrior Jaeger Ojanen , and he proved ferocious in battle, tipping the odds in Bryce's favor and allowing the city's defenders to chase the Tirrans out.
